statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and dizziness
There is concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and supraventricular tachycardia
The service was ordered to capture intermittent arrhythmic events
The service was ordered to correlate events with symptomatic complaints of giddiness
The service was ordered to assist in confirming the diagnosis
The service was ordered to guide appropriate rate or rhythm control therapy
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
